dataset.target_semantics: Sotavento Energy interpreted as 10-minute kWh and normalized by 17.56 MW; source unit remains a documented working interpretation

split_contract.rule: issue time, full context, and target time must remain inside the same split

task.history_requirement: all 144 target observations must be finite and contiguous

persistence.description: forecast every horizon with the latest observed output

ridge_direct_ar.selection: choose alpha independently per horizon using validation RMSE only

nwp_policy.reason: NWP.csv has target timestamps but no forecast issue time or lead-time metadata, so availability at each prediction issue cannot yet be audited without leakage ambiguity

metrics.ramp_event_threshold: train-only 90th percentile of abs(target - issue value), separately per horizon

success_gate.aggregation: equal-weight arithmetic mean of the six horizon-specific validation RMSE values
success_gate.qualified_forecaster: mean validation RMSE improves at least 5% over persistence, at least 4 of 6 horizons improve, and no horizon is more than 5% worse
success_gate.fallback: if the gate fails, retain persistence as the W3/E6 forecast baseline and report ridge_direct_ar as a negative lightweight comparison

forecast_interface.control_rule: none holds the issue-time reference; perfect_foresight is an information upper bound and never a deployable method
